title: feat(fields): RecordPicker lookup_filters, cell formatter, FilterUI integration, ObjectGrid reuse
body:
Implements four high-priority RecordPicker features to complete the enterprise Record Picker upgrade: schema-driven filter injection, type-aware cell rendering, FilterUI integration via slot architecture, and ObjectGrid reuse via render prop injection.

### lookup_filters consumption

- `RecordPickerDialog` accepts `lookupFilters: LookupFilterDef[]`, converts operators (`eq`→direct, `ne`→`$ne`, `in`→`$in`, etc.) to `$filter` Record, injected into every `DataSource.find()` call
- Filters persist through search, sort, and pagination
- `LookupField` reads `lookup_filters` from field metadata and passes through

### Cell Type Formatter

- `RecordPickerDialog` accepts optional `cellRenderer: CellRendererResolver` prop
- Columns with a `type` property (e.g. `currency`, `date`, `select`, `boolean`) are rendered via the resolver; falls back to plain text
- Circular dependency (`index.tsx` → `LookupField` → `RecordPickerDialog` → `index.tsx`) broken via `_cell-renderer-bridge.ts` singleton pattern

### FilterUI filter bar integration

- Built-in inline filter bar between search input and table, toggled via button with active-count badge
- Supports text/number/select/date/boolean inputs; values merged with `lookupFilters`
- `LookupField` auto-derives `filterColumns` from `lookup_columns` entries that have `type` via `mapFieldTypeToFilterType()`
- **`renderFilterBar` slot prop** allows injecting the actual `FilterUI` component from `@object-ui/plugin-view` (avoids circular dependency since `plugin-view` depends on `fields`)
- Exports `RecordPickerFilterBarProps` interface with `filterColumns`, `values`, `onChange`, `onClear`, `activeCount`
- Auto-generates `filterColumns` from `lookupFilters` when no explicit `filterColumns` prop is provided, inferring input types from value types and operators

### ObjectGrid table reuse

- Built-in table with drag-to-resize column handles (`cursor-col-resize`, min-width 60px), `table-layout: fixed` when resized
- **`renderGrid` slot prop** allows injecting `ObjectGrid` from `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (avoids circular dependency since `plugin-grid` depends on `fields`)
- Exports `RecordPickerGridSlotProps` interface with `columns`, `records`, `loading`, `totalCount`, `currentPage`, `pageSize`, `sortField`, `sortDirection`, `onSort`, `onPageChange`, `onRowClick`, `isSelected`, `multiple`, `idField`, `cellRenderer`
- Built-in table serves as default fallback when no `renderGrid` is provided

```tsx
<RecordPickerDialog
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  dataSource={ds}
  objectName="customers"
  columns={[
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name' },
    { field: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: 'currency' },
    { field: 'status', label: 'Status', type: 'select' },
  ]}
  lookupFilters={[{ field: 'active', operator: 'eq', value: true }]}
  cellRenderer={getCellRenderer}
  filterColumns={[
    { field: 'status', label: 'Status', type: 'select', options: [...] },
  ]}
  // Inject FilterUI from plugin-view
  renderFilterBar={(props) => (
    <FilterUI
      schema={{ type: 'filter-ui', filters: props.filterColumns, layout: 'inline' }}
      onChange={(values) => Object.entries(values).forEach(([k, v]) => props.onChange(k, v))}
    />
  )}
  // Inject ObjectGrid from plugin-grid
  renderGrid={(props) => (
    <ObjectGrid
      schema={{ type: 'object-grid', objectName, columns: props.columns }}
      dataSource={dataSource}
    />
  )}
  onSelect={handleSelect}
/>
```

### Tests

37 record-picker tests (17 new) covering filter injection (3), cell formatting (3), filter bar rendering (3), column resize handles (2), renderFilterBar slot (2), renderGrid slot (2), and auto-generated filter bar from lookupFilters (2). All 412 existing tests continue to pass.
